model: Free-space Biot-Savart contribution from prescribed returning-channel current

parameters.separation_convention: Fixed once so the prior single-delay1.2 corresponds to the shortest leading path in its old leading clock; not a measured or solved physical separation

endpoint.limitation: These are formal continuum-channel endpoint limits. At finite q, nu*q of order one loses localization; its unmodeled QFT contribution is not bounded by the formal tail.

mouth_excision.scope: Bounds remove only the assumed flat point-current. Unknown throat/interface and curved-region currents have no bound here.

equations.current: jhat_phi=-(t cross curvature)_phi/(12 Lbar(nu)^2), unit tangent t; jhat=j*d^3.
equations.normalization: I=integral_0^2 G(nu)dnu/2; delta Bphysical_z=g^2 I/d^2; delta cg_magnetic=16*pi^2*alpha*I/d^2.
equations.additive_data: cg_magnetic=classical_companion+formal_volume_current+unknown_correction_where_the_model_fails/interface. Replacing an invalid modeled region requires actual-minus-modeled current, not double counting. The coupled metric/master boundary data are still unselected.

scope: Leading static flat-region current on prescribed reference geometry and current67 periods. Source-generated particular only, without artificial patch clamping.
